heading: INT. ABANDONED OBSERVATORY, MAIN DOME - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ABANDONED OBSERVATORY, MAIN DOME - NIGHT
A great copper dome, its slit open to the stars, hangs overhead like the underside of a bell.
A brass telescope as long as a bus rests on a cracked iron mount.
Dead leaves cover the floor.
A single lantern burns on a crate.
CASPIAN ROTH, fifties, in a long gray coat, sits on an overturned bucket with a laptop open on his knees.
He types, stops, types again.
His face glows pale blue.
Beside him, a satellite phone lies on the crate, its screen dark.
He lifts his head.
The dome creaks in a wind that shouldn't be there.
Come on. Come on.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: He types.
The telescope's great eye twitches an inch to the left, and a gear somewhere shrieks.
He freezes.
The dome is still.
That's not me.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: He closes the laptop slowly and reaches for the phone.
As he does, a shape detaches itself from the shadow beneath the telescope and walks forward into the light: ODETTE LACROIX, forties, in a black raincoat, bare hands, no bag.
She is soaked to the skin.
A thin line of water drips from her hem onto the dead leaves with every step.
Don't touch the phone.
units.name: ODETTE

units.text: How long have you been here?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Since before you.
units.name: ODETTE

units.text: That's impossible. I locked the door.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Which door?
units.name: ODETTE

units.text: He looks at the entrance, a heavy oak slab bolted from inside.
Then at the slit overhead.
Then at her wet coat.
Who sent you?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Nobody sends me. I'm the one who stays.
units.name: ODETTE

units.text: She crosses to the crate and looks down at the dead phone, then at the laptop, then at him.
Her eyes are tired, not unkind.
You came here to upload something.
units.name: ODETTE

units.text: Data. Just data.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Data about the star?
units.name: ODETTE

units.text: How do you
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: I'm the last person who could read it.
units.name: ODETTE

units.text: A long silence.
A gust of cold air sweeps through the dome.
The lantern gutters, steadies.
Is anyone else here?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Only the telescope.
units.name: ODETTE

units.text: It moved.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: It does that when someone looks.
units.name: ODETTE

units.text: He sets the laptop on the crate and stands.
She doesn't step back.
Their shadows overlap on the leaf-strewn floor.
Miss, I don't know what
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Caspian. Sit down. You'll want to hear this sitting.
units.name: ODETTE

units.text: He stays standing.
Then, slowly, as if all his joints have turned to paper, he lowers himself back onto the bucket.
She picks up the lantern and holds it between them, so that each of them is lit and neither is.
Tell me what you saw.
units.name: ODETTE
